author: Rachel Cusk
synopsis: A woman living with her family in an isolated coastal area offers the use of her guesthouse to a renowned painter. Deeply captivated by his artwork, she hopes his unique perspective will help her unlock a profound personal mystery. However, as an unseasonably arid summer wears on, the artist's unsettling demeanor transforms into a puzzle of its own, ultimately shattering the tranquility of her isolated home.
title: Second Place
